product_name: Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra 5G (Titanium Gray, 256 GB)
review_title: Display and AI features are unreal!
review_text: The flat anti-reflective Gorilla Armor display is unbelievable outdoors. Circle to Search and live call translation work like magic. The S-Pen integration is super smooth. Value for money flagship!

product_name: Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra 5G (Titanium Gray, 256 GB)
review_title: Camera shutter lag and grainy low light photos
review_text: Moving pets or kids always come out blurry due to indoor shutter delay. For a 1 lakh+ rupee phone, camera processing should be sharper. Battery is good though.

product_name: Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra 5G (Titanium Gray, 256 GB)
review_title: Worst Flipkart delivery! Open box delivery was refused
review_text: Delivery partner refused to allow open box inspection and forced OTP verification first. Found dent on corner frame. Customer service support has been running me in circles for 10 days!

product_name: boAt Airdopes 141 Bluetooth Truly Wireless in Ear Earbuds
review_title: Paisa vasool! Bass is thumping and battery is solid
review_text: Best earbuds under 1500 rupees. Beast mode low latency works great for casual gaming. 42 hours total playtime with case is legitimately accurate. Very happy with Flipkart purchase!

product_name: boAt Airdopes 141 Bluetooth Truly Wireless in Ear Earbuds
review_title: Left bud stopped pairing after 20 days
review_text: Only right earbud plays sound now. Followed all reset instructions on manual but left side shows no light. Flipkart return window closed after 7 days, boAt service center is 30km away.

product_name: boAt Airdopes 141 Bluetooth Truly Wireless in Ear Earbuds
review_title: Mic is strictly average for noisy outdoor calls
review_text: Good for music and video playback indoors. But on bike or bus, mic captures traffic noise and listener can't hear voice clearly. Decent for the low price.

product_name: PUMA Nitro Running Shoes
review_title: Extremely bouncy and lightweight
review_text: Super comfortable for daily 5km jogs. The nitrogen-infused foam gives awesome rebound. Looks stylish with jeans too. Original genuine product received from Flipkart.

product_name: PUMA Nitro Running Shoes
review_title: Sole rubber detached after 3 weeks of walking
review_text: Defective piece or counterfeit batch! The outer tread started peeling off from the heel. Very cheap glue quality. Requested refund immediately.
